SELECT 
    c.name AS company,
    av.fiscal_year,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS net_income
FROM annual_values av
JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Netflix'
  AND av.metric = 'net_income'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2021

SELECT sector
FROM companies
WHERE name = 'Amcor'

SELECT cik AS cik
FROM companies
WHERE name = 'Walmart'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS company_count
FROM companies

SELECT 
    c.name,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS revenue
FROM annual_values av
JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE av.metric = 'revenue'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022
ORDER BY av.value DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    c.name AS company,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS r_and_d_expense
FROM annual_values av
JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE av.metric = 'research_and_development'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2021
ORDER BY av.value DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
    c.name,
    av_div.fiscal_year,
    ROUND(av_div.value / av_net.value, 2) AS dividend_payout_ratio
FROM companies AS c
JOIN annual_values AS av_div
    ON c.cik = av_div.cik
    AND av_div.metric = 'dividends_paid'
    AND av_div.fiscal_year = 2022
JOIN annual_values AS av_net
    ON c.cik = av_net.cik
    AND av_net.metric = 'net_income'
    AND av_net.fiscal_year = 2022
WHERE c.name = 'PepsiCo'

WITH capex AS (
    SELECT cik, value AS capex
    FROM annual_values
    WHERE metric = 'capital_expenditure' AND fiscal_year = 2020
),
opcf AS (
    SELECT cik, value AS operating_cf
    FROM annual_values
    WHERE metric = 'operating_cash_flow' AND fiscal_year = 2020
)
SELECT 
    co.name,
    co.ticker,
    ROUND(capex.capex, 2) AS capital_expenditure,
    ROUND(opcf.operating_cf, 2) AS operating_cash_flow
FROM capex
JOIN opcf USING (cik)
JOIN companies AS co ON co.cik = capex.cik
WHERE capex.capex > opcf.operating_cf
ORDER BY co.name

WITH amazon AS (
    SELECT cik
    FROM companies
    WHERE name = 'Amazon'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(capex.value / rev.value * 100.0), 2) AS avg_capex_pct
FROM annual_values AS capex
JOIN annual_values AS rev
    ON capex.cik = rev.cik
   AND capex.fiscal_year = rev.fiscal_year
JOIN amazon ON capex.cik = amazon.cik
WHERE capex.metric = 'capital_expenditure'
  AND rev.metric = 'revenue'
  AND capex.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2022

WITH rev AS (
    SELECT 
        av.cik,
        c.name,
        av.fiscal_year,
        av.value,
        LAG(av.value) OVER (PARTITION BY av.cik ORDER BY av.fiscal_year) AS prev_value
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE av.metric = 'revenue'
      AND av.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2022
)
SELECT name
FROM rev
GROUP BY cik, name
HAVING COUNT(*) = 5
   AND MIN(fiscal_year) = 2018
   AND MAX(fiscal_year) = 2022
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN prev_value IS NOT NULL AND value > prev_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4

SELECT av.tag
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Nike'
  AND av.metric = 'inventory'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022
